prompt: Umbraco 17. Our DPO wants all YouTube embeds to use youtube-nocookie.com. I wrote a provider that outputs a youtube-nocookie iframe and registered it with builder.EmbedProviders().Append<YouTubeNoCookieProvider>(), but editors still get normal youtube.com embeds. What's wrong?
expectations: The agent explains that IOEmbedService uses the first registered provider whose UrlSchemeRegex matches the URL
The agent explains that Append places the custom provider after the built-in YouTube provider, so the built-in still handles YouTube URLs
The fix uses Replace<YouTube, ...>() (InsertBefore/Insert, or Remove plus Append, also acceptable)
The custom provider's regex covers the YouTube URL shapes editors paste (at least youtu.be and youtube.com/watch)
The agent does not claim that youtube-nocookie alone guarantees legal/GDPR compliance
If no buildable project is available, the agent does not claim the code was compiled or run
